# Daily Briefing – Sunday 26 October

Yesterday was a quieter day — no training session logged and 6,392 steps, which is fine for a rest day. You burned 2,522 kcal against your 2,300 target, so the deficit is working, but keep an eye on fuelling quality rather than just quantity.

Your recovery markers need attention today. HRV at 66ms is well below your 98–120ms baseline, and stress sitting at 58/100 suggests your system is under strain. If you had a session planned, dial it back — think easy movement, a walk, or light stretching rather than anything structured. Your body is asking for restoration, not stimulus.

Sleep is the priority tonight. Six hours and eighteen minutes simply isn't enough to drive the recovery your HRV is flagging. Aim for 8 hours — put your phone down an hour earlier. That one change will do more for your Chester prep than any extra training session this week.
